why: Insight lab 2026-W48, candidate 1 (medium): llms.txt presence follows the site builder. Wix 32 of 33 homepages, Squarespace 3 of 33, others 591 of 1,187. Six purposive samples, 1,253 homepages, 26 Oct to 28 Nov 2026. Mechanism documented by Wix's help center (updated 9 Sep 2026). Slide images (1080x1350 PNG, brand colors and type) are in the private repo at data/insight/2026-W48/carousel/; the inbox cannot attach files.
title: Carousel: llms.txt follows the site builder (9 slides)

drafts.text:
Slide 1: 32 of 33 Wix homepages had an llms.txt file. Squarespace: 3 of 33.

Slide 2: 1,253 homepages. Small B2B SaaS, agencies, professional-services firms. Six samples, 26 Oct to 28 Nov 2026.

Slide 3: Every other platform: 591 of 1,187. About half.

Slide 4: You might read an llms.txt file as a sign someone planned for AI crawlers. Here it mostly marks the builder.

Slide 5: Wix says it "automatically generates and maintains" the file. Edit it and the updates stop.

Slide 6: Squarespace appears to need an opt-in. We have not confirmed that in its own documentation.

Slide 7: On Wix, a generator wrote the summary of your firm. You may never have read it.

Slide 8: Monday morning: open yourdomain.com/llms.txt. Read it. Correct what is wrong.

Slide 9: Method: found by web search, not random. 33 sites per builder. One scan each. Readiness only. Confidence: medium. Free scan: https://getcitehound.com/?utm_source=linkedin_page&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=field-notes&utm_content=insight-2026-W48-1-carousel
